# Shared test vectors of the control API request signing (specs/control-api.md sections 5 and 12).
# Consumed by tests/rot2k_control_api_unit.c (C), tests/rot2k_control_api_sign_test.sh (tools/akam-api-sign.sh) and, later,
# the Go client tests. Expected values were produced with openssl, not with the C code.
#
# Format: blocks separated by blank lines; "name: value" lines (first ':' splits, one optional space after it).
# "case" blocks: inputs (secret hex, key_id, method, path, query = RAW query without '?', body_hex or body_fill =
#   "<2 hex digits>:<count>", timestamp, nonce) and expected outputs: canonical_query, canonical (a literal backslash-n
#   stands for a newline; the line has no other backslash), signature (hex HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical string).
#   The method is upper-cased by every signer ("method: get" signs GET). A challenge-mode case puts "challenge:<hex>" in
#   timestamp and nonce.
# "reject" blocks: kind = path | query; value = the input a verifier must refuse (HTTP 400) and a signer must not sign.
# Canonical query: a parameter without '=' becomes "name="; sort bytewise on the re-encoded name, then value; an empty
#   segment or %00 is malformed.
